newsitem.title: SPAIN: Small bomb explodes in Barcelona; no ETA link seen.
newsitem.headline: Small bomb explodes in Barcelona; no ETA link seen.

text.p: A small homemade bomb exploded on Friday in the offices of a Barcelona radio station, causing only minor damage and no injuries, a spokeswoman for the station said.

The spokeswoman said there was no reason to believe the blast was linked to the separatist guerrilla group ETA. The rebels killed a Basque politician last weekend, sparking massive street protests throughout Spain.
The director of Barcelona's COM Radio said an anonymous caller speaking in the Basque language phoned the station on Thursday and declared "Long live the Basque country".
Two men in business suits delivered a package on Friday morning. A cleaning woman moved it, and minutes later it exploded, the station's spokeswoman said.
Police declined to provide details about the blast, but said the homemade bomb was similar to small explosive devices that went off last month in Barcelona's cathedral and had no links to ETA.
Spanish authorities have been on a high state of alert this week fearing further attacks by Basque guerrillas following the killing of 29-year-old Miguel Angel Blanco.
